locations.note: A retired detective is kidnapped and his niece hunts for leads in scenes filmed at around 17 real Sydney locations.
The Opera House is the first landmark of Act One and the target of the bombings.
A silver key is found under a seat at the Town Hall.
The player talks to Reg in The Rocks.
The player meets Michael Iden on a bench near the fountain in Hyde Park.
The player gives cash to Snakey in Kings Cross, who mentions Jessica Doe.
The Act Four climax is a bomb case under the Harbour Bridge and a final meeting there.

routes.name: The niece
routes.note: From the Opera House to the Harbour Bridge.
